High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Court No. - 75
Case :- Application U/S 528 Bnss No. - 23954 of 2025
Applicant :- Anurodh Alias Ganesh And 2 Others

Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another
Counsel for Applicant :- Ronak Chaturvedi
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Vikas Budhwar,J.
1.

Vakalatnama has been filed on behalf of Shri Sanjay Pathak (A/S 2322/13), counsel for opposite
party no.2, is taken on record.
2. Heard Sri Ronak Chaturvedi, learned counsel for the applicants and Sri Kripa Shanker, learned A.G.A. for the State as well as Shri Sanjay Pathak (A/S 2322/13) counsel for the opposite party no. 2.

3. This application under Section 528 BNSS has been filed by the applicants to quash the proceedings of Complaint Case No.636 of 2015 (Asha @ Shaifali vs. Anurodh @ Ganesh), under Section 498A, 323, 504, 506 IPC and Section 3/4 of D.P. Act, Police Station Nebua Naurangiya,
District Kushinagar, pending in the Court of Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate/Civil Judge (S.D)/FTC at Kushinagar, Padrauna.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

entities.text: Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate/Civil Judge (S.D)/FTC at Kushinagar
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
4. Learned counsel for the applicants has submitted that during the pendency of the said Anurodh Alias Ganesh And 2 Others vs State Of U.P. And Another on 9 July, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/106945390/
1 proceedings, the parties took recourse to mediation before the District Court Mediation Centre and there happens to be an order dated 31.07.2024 at page 40 of the paper book (annexure-4 at page 37)
on wards reference whereof has been made in para-16 of the application.

entities.text: Anurodh Alias Ganesh And 2 Others vs State Of U.P. And Another on 9 July, 2025 Indian Kanoon
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
Learned counsel for the applicants submits that once the mediation has been successful and parties have entered into settlement and nothing remains to be proceeded with.
5.
Learned AGA as well as counsel for the opposite party no. 2 have no objection to the same.

6. Considering the submissions so made across the bar and bearing in mind the fact that the matter stood resolved between the applicants and opposite party no. 2 in Mediation and Conciliation Centre, Kushinagar, Padrauna and there happens to be an order dated 31.07.2024 thus nothing remains to be proceeded with.
7. Accordingly, the application is disposed of.

8. The proceedings of Complaint Case No.636 of 2015 (Asha @ Shaifali vs. Anurodh @ Ganesh),
under Section 498A, 323, 504, 506 IPC and Section 3/4 of D.P. Act, Police Station Nebua Naurangiya, District Kushinagar, pending in the Court of Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate/Civil Judge (S.D)/FTC at Kushinagar, Padrauna are quashed against the applicants.
